+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must not be negative", ttl)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", ttl, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must not be negative", ttl)
+	}
+	return durationpb.New(d), nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+
+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication preserving casing of first occurrence)
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Headers))
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hdr := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+				HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+			}
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash header %q invalid regex pattern: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+				}
+				hdr.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+					Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+						Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					},
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+			hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+					Header: hdr,
+				},
+			}
+			if h.Terminal != nil {
+				hp.Terminal = *h.Terminal
+			}
+			ir.headers = append(ir.headers, hp)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			if _, exists := seen[c.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+				Name: c.Name,
+			}
+			if c.TTL != nil {
+				ttlDur, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+				if err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash cookie %q: %w", c.Name, err)
+				}
+				cookie.Ttl = ttlDur
+			}
+			if c.Path != nil {
+				cookie.Path = *c.Path
+			}
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+				for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+					attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+						Name:  attr.Name,
+						Value: attr.Value,
+					})
+				}
+				cookie.Attributes = attrs
+			}
+			hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+					Cookie: cookie,
+				},
+			}
+			if c.Terminal != nil {
+				hp.Terminal = *c.Terminal
+			}
+			ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, hp)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			if _, exists := seen[qp.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: qp.Name,
+					},
+				},
+			}
+			if qp.Terminal != nil {
+				hp.Terminal = *qp.Terminal
+			}
+			ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, hp)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key)
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+		for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+			if _, exists := seen[fs.Key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: fs.Key,
+					},
+				},
+			}
+			if fs.Terminal != nil {
+				hp.Terminal = *fs.Terminal
+			}
+			ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, hp)
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if ch.SourceIp.Terminal != nil {
+			hp.Terminal = *ch.SourceIp.Terminal
+		}
+		ir.sourceIp = hp
+	}
+
+	ir.buildHashPolicies()
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaderHashPolicies(
+	first, second []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+) ([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, bool) {
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(first)+len(second))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(first)+len(second))
+	for _, hp := range first {
+		key := strings.ToLower(hp.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	secondContributed := false
+	for _, hp := range second {
+		key := strings.ToLower(hp.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+		secondContributed = true
+	}
+	if len(out) == 0 {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return out, secondContributed
+}
+
+func deduplicateHashPoliciesByKey(
+	first, second []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	keyFn func(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string,
+) ([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, bool) {
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(first)+len(second))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(first)+len(second))
+	for _, hp := range first {
+		key := keyFn(hp)
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	secondContributed := false
+	for _, hp := range second {
+		key := keyFn(hp)
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+		secondContributed = true
+	}
+	if len(out) == 0 {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return out, secondContributed
+}
+
+// mergeConsistentHashIRs merges high and low priority consistentHashIRs by unioning
+// array fields (high priority first, deduplicated by key), keeping high priority's sourceIp
+// scalar even when unset, and re-sorting into canonical type order.
+func mergeConsistentHashIRs(high, low *consistentHashIR) (merged *consistentHashIR, lowContributed bool) {
+	headers, hContrib := deduplicateHeaderHashPolicies(high.headers, low.headers)
+	cookies, cContrib := deduplicateHashPoliciesByKey(high.cookies, low.cookies, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetCookie().GetName()
+	})
+	queryParams, qpContrib := deduplicateHashPoliciesByKey(high.queryParameters, low.queryParameters, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetQueryParameter().GetName()
+	})
+	filterState, fsContrib := deduplicateHashPoliciesByKey(high.filterState, low.filterState, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+		return hp.GetFilterState().GetKey()
+	})
+
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		headers:         headers,
+		cookies:         cookies,
+		queryParameters: queryParams,
+		filterState:     filterState,
+		sourceIp:        high.sourceIp,
+	}
+	out.buildHashPolicies()
+	return out, hContrib || cContrib || qpContrib || fsContrib
+}
